title: dactylorhiza cruenta subsp. salina
intro: Dactylorhiza cruenta subsp. salina, commonly known as the Salt Marsh Coeloglossum, is a subspecies of orchid plant that is native to salt marshes and coastal areas. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza cruenta subsp. salina include wound healing, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of this plant for medicinal use.
